label: Diagram 5
caption: Diagram 5 Schematic example of gigabit-ready physical infrastructure for an individual dwelling
description: This is a schematic diagram, captioned at the bottom in a green band as "Diagram 5 Schematic example of gigabit-ready physical infrastructure for an individual dwelling". The drawing shows a simple front elevation of a house: a thick light green outline of the walls and roof, a horizontal light green line marking the upper floor, and a thin horizontal ground line. To the left of the house outline are two symbols, consisting of two thick green outlined squares joined by a short horizontal line. The left square is labelled "Access point". The right square is labelled "Network termination point". A solid black line starts below the line joining the two squares, runs down to the ground line, then curves left and continues as a dashed black line extending off to the left. Beneath this line is a block of text reading: "Gigabit-ready physical infrastructure (ducting) to the distribution point or, where there is no access right up to the distribution point, as close as is reasonably practicable to a distribution point. In some cases, there will be no gigabit-ready physical infrastructure beyond the access point."
